t: This is Catherine Street, which runs from Russell Street in the north down to Aldwych. It was originally called Brydges Street. Tavistock Street crosses it midway, and the eastern end of Exeter Street joins it on the western side near Aldwych. The name honours Catherine of Braganza, who was Queen of England, Scotland and Ireland through her marriage to Charles II. The dancer, comedian and actor Lydia Thompson, who also produced theatre, was born here.
